title: ledum tomentosum
intro: Ledum tomentosum, commonly known as bog rosemary, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the heath family (Ericaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ledum tomentosum include stimulating the immune system, reducing fever, and treating respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Ledum tomentosum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
